{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the conversion rate calculation
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted orders per segment
conversion_rates = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

# Check if the groups are comparable across channels
# The data dictionary says: channel was not randomly assigned — email was targeted at loyal customers
# So we must check whether customer_segment is confounded with channel

# Cross-tabulate customer_segment and channel
tab = pd.crosstab(df['customer_segment'], df['channel'])
print(tab)

# Check if the distribution of segments differs by channel
print("\nSegment distribution by channel:")
print(df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
